findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.comment: Inspector observed the only employee present during today’s inspection to not have a Certified Food Protection Manager’s (CFPM) Certificate. CORRECTED- an additional employee with their CFPM arrived. A CFPM should be present at all times food is being prepared or served. Ensure a CFPM is present at all times food (that is not prepackaged) is being served.
findings.citation_text: 2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.comment: Employees were unable to locate Employee Reporting Agreements, but did state they had signed them. Inspector will return on 10/07/25 to view Employee Reporting Agreements. Ensure they are on file and available at any time a future inspection may occur.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).[Pf]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a biofilm accumulated around the soda nozzles. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) replaced the soda nozzles and took the ones that had been on the machine to be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of soil residues, and to prevent contamination of ready to eat (RTE) food and drinks.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Inspector and employees could not locate test strips that correspond with the sanitizer in the facility. The facility is using quaternary ammonia as their sanitizing solution, but have Chlorine test strips. Inspector will return on or before (if the facility obtains them before the follow up date) 10/07/25 to ensure that facility has test strips that correspond with their sanitizer solution.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the coving that seals the floor to the wall peeling from the wall underneath the electrical panel in the stock room. Reseal the coving to the wall to prevent entry of water, which could harbor mold.
2) Inspector observed a large hole cut in the drywall behind the soda boxes in the stock room. This hole exposes drywall edges and bare wood. Cover or repair this wall so that it is smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspector observed cracked and missing floor tiles in front of the self service soda station, as well as in the men’s restroom. Repair or replace tiles by the next routine inspection, so that surfaces are smooth and easily cleanable.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
1) Caulking around the mop sink is cracked and separated from the wall. Recaulk the mop sink.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
Two containers of FairLife reduced fat milk observed with manufacturer expiration dates of 11/16/2023. CORRECTED- Milk was voluntarily discarded.
3-501.18: (A) FOOD shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time criteria. If container or PACKAGE does not bear a date or day or if inappropriately marked with date or day exceeding temperature and time combination. (B) Refrigerated RTE TCS FOOD prepared in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT and dispensed through vending machine shall be discarded if exceeding temperature and time. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Caulk around the handwashing sink counter observed to be damaged/deteriorating. Recaulk countertop to the wall.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM)
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12 PIC at the time of inspector’s arrival did not have proof of a food manager certification. PIC noted they have a food handler certification and are working to complete the manager certification. The store manager came back to deliver product and stayed for the remainder of inspection. Another employee with manager certification arrived for the evening shift. Ensure a certified food manager is on-site during all hours of prep/food service.
Person in charge at the time of inspection shall be a certified food protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an accredited program.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11 (O) Signed reporting agreement was not available for an employee working at the time of inspection. Employee health policy was discussed, and employee signed reporting agreement during inspection. Ensure all staff are educated on the employee health policy upon hiring and sign reporting agreements prior to beginning their first shift. Maintain signed copies of reporting agreements for staff.
The person in charge shall ensure that food employees are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with law, to the person in charge, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through food, as specified under ¶ 2-201.11(A).

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
6-301.11 Men’s restroom hand soap dispenser was empty. Soap was provided during inspection.
Each handwashing sink shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text:
3-305.11 Shrink wrapped packages of bottled water available for purchase were observed outside the facility on display. Store manager was advised the bottled water needs to be stored in the facility. Store manager called her supervisor during inspection so information could be shared directly with upper management. Packages of bottled water were relocated to the walk-in cooler during inspection.
Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food in a clean, dry location; where it is not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and at least 6 inches above the floor.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11 Packages of raw bacon were stored above milk in the reach-in cooler section of the cooler. Manager rearranged products during inspection to allow for proper storage of raw below ready to eat foods. 
Food shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display by separating raw animal foods from ready to eat foods.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.citation_text:
3-304.11 A half dozen fruit flies were observed on soda nozzles at the fountain drink machine. Staff are working to keep the service area clean. Nozzles in question were removed to be cleaned and sanitized. Closely monitor the conditions at the fountain drink machine and remove nozzles for cleaning throughout the day as needed based on the current conditions concerning the presence of fruit flies.
Food shall only contact surfaces of equipment and utensils that are cleaned and sanitized as specified under Parts 4-6 and 4-7 of the 2017 FDA Food Code

findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present
findings.citation_text:
6-501.111 Facility currently has a fruit fly infestation. Dozens of fruit flies were observed at and around the Froster machine and the beverage areas adjacent to the machine where coffee and fountain soda are located. Fruit flies were on the walls, surfaces of equipment, and on single service items. Flies were also observed in the restrooms, manager’s office, and sporadically in the back storage area. The Froster machine is the source of the infestation based on the conditions observed and an ongoing leak that has been an issue from the bottom of the machine. The machine has been off for 3 weeks now and certain hot food items are not being placed out for service due to concerns of cross contamination. Multiple work orders have been placed by store manager, with the most recent request for steam cleaning inside the machine being approved. The machine in question either needs to be properly cleaned and maintained to eliminate the presence of flies or should be replaced if it is beyond remediation. Call pest control company for service to assist with fly management. **See general comments for additional information.**
The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests shall be controlled to eliminate their presence by routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies; routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests; using methods, if pests are found, such as trapping devices or other means of pest control as specified under §§ 7-202.12, 7-206.12, and 7-206.13; and eliminating harborage conditions.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text:
4-903.11 Fruit flies were observed on uncovered coffee filters located on top of the creamer dispenser at the coffee counter. Coffee filters were discarded. Store coffee filters covered in a sealed container or in original packaging.
Store manager will be discarding some items due to the presence of fruit flies on and around unpackaged single service items at the Froster machine and adjacent beverage areas.
Single service and single use articles shall be stored in a clean, dry location, where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above the floor.
